newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market quiet, no trade-private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market quiet, no trade-private.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle sales near midday Friay were quiet, with no reported sales, market sources said.
"The showlist this week has basically been picked clean and I would expect a steady to smaller list next week," a Nebraska cattleman said.

Sales this week were mostly at $104.00 per cwt on a dressed basis, with some at $105.00 on Thursday. Cattle on a live basis sold mostly at $64.00, with a few at $65.00 and a limited few at $65.50 in western Nebraska, sources said.
Cattle were seen priced $106-$107 on Monday, they said.
